_doc: Boxes are level-0 canvas px [y0, y1, x0, x1] of supervised components from logs/components_*.log (scripts/list_components.py: level-4 supervision after a 48 px dilation). build_labels.py maps them into the tifxyz frame with the HF65 correction and pads by margin_px. Held-out: w018 = the three components fully inside the shipped w018_20240304144031_validation_mask_v2 (ids 5, 7, 14; 11.8% of its ink); w00 = ids 10, 12, 14 (20.8% of its ink; w00 ships no validation mask). guard_px of supervision around every held-out box is dropped from training in every arm. Smoke boxes restrict the CPU smoke test to one training and one held-out component per segment so it reads few CT chunks.
